Stream produces events for multi-depth crawl with link following

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"max_concurrent\":1,\"max_depth\":2}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var urlReq = new CrawlStreamRequest(url);
        var result = engine.crawlStream(urlReq);
        try (result) {
        result.forEach(resultChunk -> {
        System.out.println(resultChunk);
        });
        }
    }
}
```
